get_account.title: Get the account
get_account.description: Return the authenticated Buffer user's account: id, email, name, avatar, timezone, preferences and the organizations they belong to (id and name). Use list_organizations for organization limits and member counts.

list_organizations.title: List organizations
list_organizations.description: List the organizations the authenticated account belongs to, with name, owner email, channel count, member count and plan limits (channels, ideas, tags, scheduled posts...). Pass organization_id to fetch just one. Almost every other Buffer tool needs one of these ids.

list_channels.title: List channels
list_channels.description: List the social channels (profiles, pages, accounts) connected to an organization that the user can see, with service, name, timezone, queue state, lock state and posting schedule. Use get_channel for one channel with its service metadata such as Pinterest boards.

is_locked.description: true for only locked channels (which cannot post), false for only unlocked ones. Omit for all.

product.description: Only channels that support this Buffer product.

get_channel.title: Get a channel
get_channel.description: Fetch one channel by id: service, type, name, timezone, posting schedule, queue and connection state, link shortening, posting goal and service metadata (Pinterest boards with their serviceId for create_post, Mastodon server, Google Business location).

get_organization_configuration.title: Get organization configuration
get_organization_configuration.description: Return an organization's capability configuration: for each connected channel, the per-feature authorization status (posting, commenting, insights...) and the content rules per content type; plus the service-level catalog for every supported service and channel type. Experimental.
get_organization_configuration.notes: Experimental in Buffer's API; Buffer documents no OAuth scope for it.

list_posts.title: List posts
list_posts.description: Page through an organization's posts, optionally filtered by channel, status (draft, scheduled, sent...), format, tags, scheduled date or creation date, and sorted. Returns post text, status, schedule, channel, tags, assets and any publishing error. Use get_post for one post.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor. Omit for the first page; reset it whenever the filters or sort change, since a cursor from another result set gives undefined results.

post_types.description: Only posts of these formats. `post` matches every post the other formats do not claim.

tag_ids.description: Only posts carrying any of these tag ids.

due_after.description: Only posts scheduled at or after this ISO 8601 time.

due_before.description: Only posts scheduled at or before this ISO 8601 time.

due_at_presence.description: present for only posts with a scheduled time, absent for only posts without one (cannot be combined with due_after/due_before).

created_after.description: Only posts created at or after this ISO 8601 time.

created_before.description: Only posts created at or before this ISO 8601 time.

start_date.description: Only posts whose createdAt or dueAt is after this ISO 8601 time.

end_date.description: Only posts whose createdAt or dueAt is before this ISO 8601 time.

sort.description: Sort criteria, each breaking ties in the previous: [{"field": "dueAt"|"createdAt", "direction": "asc"|"desc"}].

edges.description: Edges, each with a cursor and a post node.

pageInfo.description: hasNextPage and endCursor for the next call.

get_post.title: Get a post
get_post.description: Fetch one post by id with its text, status, schedule (dueAt, sentAt, shareMode), channel, tags, assets, author, notes and any publishing error. Use list_posts to find posts by channel, status or date.

post_id.description: Post id, from list_posts or create_post.

create_post.title: Create a post
create_post.description: Create a post on one channel: add it to the queue, share it next, share it now, schedule it for due_at, or save it as a draft. Returns the created post, or an error message (invalid input, limit reached) in `message`. Use create_content_item to post the same content to several channels as one item, and create_idea for unscheduled ideas.
create_post.notes: mode shareNow publishes to the social network immediately.

channel_id.description: Channel to post to, from list_channels.

mode.description: addToQueue (next free queue slot), shareNext (top of the queue), shareNow (publish immediately) or customScheduled (at due_at).

scheduling_type.description: automatic: Buffer publishes it. notification: Buffer reminds someone to publish it by hand.

needs_approval.description: Submit for approval instead of scheduling; only valid when the channel's posting policy requires approval.

text.description: Post text. For threaded posts it must match the first item of metadata.<service>.thread.

due_at.description: When to publish, ISO 8601. Required with mode customScheduled.

save_to_draft.description: Save as a draft instead of scheduling it; drafts skip posting limits and never publish until scheduled.

assets.description: Ordered assets. Each item is an AssetInput with exactly one key: {"image": {"url": ..., "metadata": {"altText": ...}}}, {"video": {"url": ..., "metadata": {"title": ..., "thumbnailOffset": ms}}} or {"document": {"url": ..., "title": ..., "thumbnailUrl": ...}}. Media must be hosted at a public URL. Mutually exclusive with a metadata.<service>.linkAttachment.

metadata.description: PostInputMetaData keyed by service: facebook {type: post|reel|story, firstComment, linkAttachment}, instagram {type: post|story|reel, shouldShareToFeed, firstComment, geolocation}, linkedin {firstComment, linkAttachment}, pinterest {boardServiceId, title, url}, youtube {title, categoryId, privacy, madeForKids}, google {type: event|offer|whats_new, detailsEvent|detailsOffer|detailsWhatsNew}, twitter/threads/bluesky/mastodon {thread: [{text, assets}]}, tiktok {title}. Required for some networks, e.g. Instagram and Facebook post type, Pinterest board, YouTube title and category.

tag_ids.description: Tag ids to apply, from list_tags.

idea_id.description: Idea id this post was made from, from list_ideas.

ai_assisted.description: Mark the post as written with the help of AI.

output.description: The created post, or an error.

edit_post.title: Edit a post
edit_post.description: Edit an existing post: change its text, schedule, assets, tags, metadata or approval state, or move it back to drafts. Omitted fields keep their current value; assets: [] clears assets. Returns the updated post or an error message. Use move_post_in_queue to only reorder the queue.

mode.description: New share mode. Omit to keep the current schedule and queue slot.

scheduling_type.description: automatic or notification publishing. Omit to keep the current one.

approval_change.description: request submits your draft for approval; revert withdraws a pending request. Only where the channel requires approval.

text.description: Post text. For threaded posts it must match the first item of metadata.<service>.thread.

due_at.description: When to publish, ISO 8601. Required with mode customScheduled.

save_to_draft.description: Save as a draft instead of scheduling it; drafts skip posting limits and never publish until scheduled.

assets.description: Ordered assets. Each item is an AssetInput with exactly one key: {"image": {"url": ..., "metadata": {"altText": ...}}}, {"video": {"url": ..., "metadata": {"title": ..., "thumbnailOffset": ms}}} or {"document": {"url": ..., "title": ..., "thumbnailUrl": ...}}. Media must be hosted at a public URL. Mutually exclusive with a metadata.<service>.linkAttachment.

metadata.description: PostInputMetaData keyed by service: facebook {type: post|reel|story, firstComment, linkAttachment}, instagram {type: post|story|reel, shouldShareToFeed, firstComment, geolocation}, linkedin {firstComment, linkAttachment}, pinterest {boardServiceId, title, url}, youtube {title, categoryId, privacy, madeForKids}, google {type: event|offer|whats_new, detailsEvent|detailsOffer|detailsWhatsNew}, twitter/threads/bluesky/mastodon {thread: [{text, assets}]}, tiktok {title}. Required for some networks, e.g. Instagram and Facebook post type, Pinterest board, YouTube title and category.

tag_ids.description: Tag ids to apply, from list_tags.

idea_id.description: Idea id this post was made from, from list_ideas.

ai_assisted.description: Mark the post as written with the help of AI.

output.description: The updated post, or an error.

delete_post.title: Delete a post
delete_post.description: Permanently delete a post by id. Returns the deleted post's id, or an error message. To detach a post from a content item without deleting it, use remove_post_from_content_item.

output.description: The deleted post id, or an error.

move_post_in_queue.title: Move a post in the queue
move_post_in_queue.description: Move a queued post to the top (next free slot) or bottom (last slot) of its channel's queue without re-validating its content. Returns the post with its new dueAt. Use edit_post to change the content or set a custom time. Experimental.

output.description: The moved post, or an error.

get_daily_posting_limits.title: Get daily posting limits
get_daily_posting_limits.description: For each given channel, report the network's daily posting limit and how many posts are already sent and scheduled on a date, and whether the channel is at its limit. Check this before scheduling many posts on one day.
get_daily_posting_limits.notes: Buffer documents no OAuth scope for this query.

channel_ids.description: Channels to check; all must belong to the same organization.

date.description: Day to check, ISO 8601. Defaults to today.

list_ideas.title: List ideas
list_ideas.description: Page through an organization's ideas (unscheduled content in the Create space) with title, text, target date, services, tags and media. Filter by idea group or tags. Use list_idea_groups for the group ids.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor. Omit for the first page; reset it whenever the filters or sort change, since a cursor from another result set gives undefined results.

group_ids.description: Only ideas in these groups. Do not combine with group_membership.

group_membership.description: grouped for only ideas in some group, ungrouped for only unassigned ones. Do not combine with group_ids.

tag_ids.description: Only return items carrying any of these tag ids (from list_tags).

include_untagged.description: With tag_ids, also include items that carry no tags at all.

edges.description: Edges, each with a cursor and a idea node.

pageInfo.description: hasNextPage and endCursor for the next call.

list_idea_groups.title: List idea groups
list_idea_groups.description: List the idea groups (board columns) of an organization with id, name and lock state. Use the ids to filter list_ideas or to place a new idea with create_idea.

create_idea.title: Create an idea
create_idea.description: Save a new idea for later: a title, text, target date, intended services, tags and media, optionally placed in an idea group. Returns the idea, or an error message (invalid input, limit reached). Use create_post to schedule content on a channel.

text.description: Main body text of the idea.

date.description: Target date, ISO 8601, used for planning.

services.description: Networks the idea is meant for.

media.description: Media to attach: [{"url": ..., "type": "image"|"gif"|"link"|"document", "alt": ..., "thumbnailUrl": ...}]. video is not supported through the public API.

tags.description: Tags to apply: [{"id": ..., "name": ..., "color": ...}] taken from list_tags.

ai_assisted.description: Mark the idea as written with AI help.

group_id.description: Idea group to place it in, from list_idea_groups. Omit for the unassigned group.

place_after_id.description: Place it after this idea in the group. Omit for the top.

list_tags.title: List tags
list_tags.description: Page through an organization's tags, sorted by name, with color and lock state, plus the total count. Use the ids in list_posts, create_post and content item filters. Experimental.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor. Omit for the first page; reset it whenever the filters or sort change, since a cursor from another result set gives undefined results.

is_locked.description: true for only locked tags, false for only unlocked ones. Omit for both.

edges.description: Edges, each with a cursor and a tag node.

pageInfo.description: hasNextPage and endCursor for the next call.

get_tag.title: Get a tag
get_tag.description: Fetch one tag by id with its name, color, palette color name and lock state. Returns null with a NOT_FOUND error when no tag has that id. Use list_tags to find tags by organization.

create_tag.title: Create a tag
create_tag.description: Create a tag in an organization. The caller must be an organization admin. Returns the tag, or a DuplicateError / LimitReachedError message when the name exists or the plan's tag limit is reached.

name.description: Display name, 1-100 characters, unique within the organization (case-sensitive).

color.description: Hex color: # followed by exactly six hex digits, e.g. #F523F1.

update_tag.title: Update a tag
update_tag.description: Replace a tag's name and color (send the current value for whichever you are not changing). Locked tags cannot be edited. Returns the tag, or an error message such as a duplicate name.

name.description: Display name, 1-100 characters, unique within the organization (case-sensitive).

color.description: Hex color: # followed by exactly six hex digits, e.g. #F523F1.

delete_tag.title: Delete a tag
delete_tag.description: Delete a tag; it is removed from every post, idea and content item carrying it, which are otherwise untouched. The caller must be an organization admin. Returns the deleted id or an error message.

output.description: The deleted tag id, or an error.

list_snippets.title: List hashtag snippets
list_snippets.description: Page through an organization's snippets (named sets of hashtags inserted into posts), sorted by name. Experimental.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor. Omit for the first page; reset it whenever the filters or sort change, since a cursor from another result set gives undefined results.

edges.description: Edges, each with a cursor and a snippet node.

pageInfo.description: hasNextPage and endCursor for the next call.

create_snippet.title: Create a hashtag snippet
create_snippet.description: Save a named set of hashtags in an organization so it can be inserted into posts. Returns the snippet, or an error message for an empty or too long name or text.

text.description: The hashtags, as the text inserted into a post, e.g. "#marketing #growth".

update_snippet.title: Update a hashtag snippet
update_snippet.description: Replace a snippet's name and text (both are replaced). Returns the updated snippet, or an error message.

delete_snippet.title: Delete a hashtag snippet
delete_snippet.description: Permanently delete a snippet from an organization. Returns the deleted snippet's id, or an error message.

output.description: The deleted id, or an error.

list_post_templates.title: List post templates
list_post_templates.description: Page through the post templates visible to the user: Buffer's public templates, the organization's internal templates and the user's private ones, with title, body ({{placeholders}}), description and emoji. Narrow with visibility.
list_post_templates.notes: Preview API; Buffer documents no OAuth scope for post templates.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor. Omit for the first page; reset it whenever the filters or sort change, since a cursor from another result set gives undefined results.

edges.description: Edges, each with a cursor and a template node.

pageInfo.description: hasNextPage and endCursor for the next call.

get_post_template.title: Get a post template
get_post_template.description: Fetch one post template by id with its title, body, description, emoji and visibility. Returns null when it does not exist. Use list_post_templates to browse.
get_post_template.notes: Preview API; Buffer documents no OAuth scope for post templates.

create_post_template.title: Create a post template
create_post_template.description: Create a reusable post template, private to the user or internal to the organization. The body may contain {{placeholders}}. Returns the template, or an error message.
create_post_template.notes: Preview API; Buffer documents no OAuth scope for post templates.

description.description: Short user-facing description (must not be empty).

visibility.description: private (only you) or internal (your organization). Defaults to private.

update_post_template.title: Update a post template
update_post_template.description: Change a post template's title, body, description, emoji or visibility; omitted fields keep their value. Works on your own templates, or internal ones if you are an org admin. Returns the template or an error.
update_post_template.notes: Preview API; Buffer documents no OAuth scope for post templates.

delete_post_template.title: Delete a post template
delete_post_template.description: Permanently delete a post template you own (or an internal one if you are an org admin). Returns EmptySuccess or an error message.
delete_post_template.notes: Preview API; Buffer documents no OAuth scope for post templates.

list_content_items.title: List content items
list_content_items.description: Page through an organization's content items (a piece of content that is a channel-less draft or a set of channel-specific posts), newest first by default, filtered by status, tags or target date. Returns title, target date, tags and the draft or posts. Experimental.
list_content_items.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pageInfo.endCursor. Omit for the first page; reset it whenever the filters or sort change, since a cursor from another result set gives undefined results.

content_status.description: draftContent for channel-less drafts, postContent for items holding posts.

tag_ids.description: Only return items carrying any of these tag ids (from list_tags).

include_untagged.description: With tag_ids, also include items that carry no tags at all.

target_date_presence.description: present for only dated items, absent for only undated ones. Do not combine with target_after/target_before.

target_after.description: Only items whose target date is at or after this ISO 8601 time.

target_before.description: Only items whose target date is at or before this ISO 8601 time.

edges.description: Edges, each with a cursor and a content item node.

pageInfo.description: hasNextPage and endCursor for the next call.

get_content_item.title: Get a content item
get_content_item.description: Fetch one content item by id with its title, target date, tags, author, allowed actions and body (the channel-less draft or its channel-specific posts). Experimental.
get_content_item.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

create_content_item.title: Create a content item with posts
create_content_item.description: Create a content item together with its channel-specific posts in one call, e.g. the same announcement for LinkedIn, X and Instagram. All-or-nothing validation: if any post is invalid nothing is created and every error is listed. Use create_content_item_draft to start without channels. Experimental.
create_content_item.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period. Posts with mode shareNow publish immediately.

posts.description: Channel-specific posts, at most one per channel. Each is a CreatePostInput: {"channelId": ..., "text": ..., "mode": "addToQueue"|"shareNext"|"shareNow"|"customScheduled", "schedulingType": "automatic"|"notification", "dueAt": ..., "assets": [...], "metadata": {...}, "saveToDraft": bool}.

target_date.description: Planning date, ISO 8601; does not schedule anything.

tag_ids.description: Tags for the item, from list_tags.

output.description: The content item, or the failure and its errors.

create_content_item_draft.title: Create a content item draft
create_content_item_draft.description: Create a content item holding a channel-less draft (text and/or assets) before any channels are picked; no network rules apply yet. Pass correlation_id to make retries idempotent. Promote it later with promote_content_item_draft_to_posts. Experimental.
create_content_item_draft.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

text.description: Draft text. May be empty when the draft holds at least one asset.

assets.description: Images, videos or documents, as AssetInput objects ({"image": {"url": ...}} etc.), in display order.

ai_assisted.description: Mark the draft as written with AI help.

correlation_id.description: Client-generated UUID; a retry with the same UUID returns the first item created.

output.description: The content item, or the failure.

update_content_item.title: Update a content item
update_content_item.description: Change a content item's title or target date; omitted fields keep their current value. To change the draft itself use update_content_item_draft; to change posts use edit_post. Experimental.
update_content_item.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

output.description: The content item, or the failure.

update_content_item_draft.title: Replace a content item draft
update_content_item_draft.description: Replace a channel-less draft's content in full (text and assets), optionally also setting tags and target date. Only valid while the item is still a draft. Experimental.
update_content_item_draft.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

text.description: Draft text. May be empty when the draft holds at least one asset.

assets.description: Images, videos or documents, as AssetInput objects ({"image": {"url": ...}} etc.), in display order.

ai_assisted.description: Mark the draft as written with AI help.

target_date.description: Planning date, ISO 8601. Omit to keep it.

tag_ids.description: Tags for the item. Omit to keep the current tags.

output.description: The content item, or the failure.

promote_content_item_draft_to_posts.title: Promote a draft to posts
promote_content_item_draft_to_posts.description: Turn a content item's channel-less draft into channel-specific posts, one per channel. One-way: the item can no longer be edited as a draft. If any post fails validation none are created. Experimental.
promote_content_item_draft_to_posts.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

posts.description: Channel-specific posts, at most one per channel. Each is a CreatePostInput: {"channelId": ..., "text": ..., "mode": "addToQueue"|"shareNext"|"shareNow"|"customScheduled", "schedulingType": "automatic"|"notification", "dueAt": ..., "assets": [...], "metadata": {...}, "saveToDraft": bool}.

tag_ids.description: Tags for the item. Omit to keep the current tags.

output.description: The content item, or the failure.

add_post_to_content_item.title: Add a post to a content item
add_post_to_content_item.description: Attach an existing post to a content item in the same organization. Creates no post; call create_post first. Returns the item and the post. Experimental.
add_post_to_content_item.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

content_item_id.description: Content item to add the post to.

output.description: The item and post, or an error.

remove_post_from_content_item.title: Remove a post from a content item
remove_post_from_content_item.description: Detach a post from its content item. The post survives on its channel with its schedule, text, status and tags; only the link goes. Use delete_post to delete it. Experimental.
remove_post_from_content_item.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

content_item_id.description: Content item to remove the post from.

output.description: The item and post, or an error.

delete_content_item.title: Delete a content item
delete_content_item.description: Delete a content item and every post created from it, plus their team notes. All-or-nothing: if any post is publishing or already published nothing is deleted and each blocked post is reported. Experimental.
delete_content_item.notes: Experimental Buffer API; may change without a deprecation period.

output.description: EmptySuccess, or the failure listing blocked posts.

get_trending_instagram_audio.title: Trending Instagram audio
get_trending_instagram_audio.description: Return Meta's trending Instagram audio (music or original sounds) for one Instagram channel, for picking a track for a Reel. Use get_instagram_audio_catalog to get both catalogs at once.
get_trending_instagram_audio.notes: Experimental. Needs an Instagram channel connected with Facebook Login; Instagram Login channels return ChannelRefreshRequired. Buffer documents no OAuth scope for it.

audio_type.description: music for licensed music, originalSound for sounds created by Instagram accounts.

output.description: Trending audio, or a refresh request.

search_instagram_audio.title: Search Instagram audio
search_instagram_audio.description: Search one Instagram audio catalog (music or original sounds) for a channel by text. Use search_instagram_audio_catalog to search both catalogs in one call.
search_instagram_audio.notes: Experimental. Needs an Instagram channel connected with Facebook Login; Instagram Login channels return ChannelRefreshRequired. Buffer documents no OAuth scope for it.

audio_type.description: music for licensed music, originalSound for sounds created by Instagram accounts.

output.description: Matching audio, or a refresh request.

get_instagram_audio_catalog.title: Instagram audio catalog
get_instagram_audio_catalog.description: Return trending music and original sounds for an Instagram channel in one request, duplicates removed, music first. failedAudioTypes lists a catalog that failed to load.
get_instagram_audio_catalog.notes: Experimental. Needs an Instagram channel connected with Facebook Login; Instagram Login channels return ChannelRefreshRequired. Buffer documents no OAuth scope for it.

output.description: Combined audio, or a refresh request.

search_instagram_audio_catalog.title: Search Instagram audio catalogs
search_instagram_audio_catalog.description: Search music and original sounds for an Instagram channel in one request, original sounds first, duplicates removed. Use search_instagram_audio to search a single catalog.
search_instagram_audio_catalog.notes: Experimental. Needs an Instagram channel connected with Facebook Login; Instagram Login channels return ChannelRefreshRequired. Buffer documents no OAuth scope for it.

query.description: Search text; must not be blank.

output.description: Matching audio, or a refresh request.

get_instagram_audio.title: Get Instagram audio
get_instagram_audio.description: Refresh metadata and preview availability (title, artist, duration, temporary preview and artwork URLs) for one Instagram audio asset by its Meta audio id.
get_instagram_audio.notes: Experimental. Needs an Instagram channel connected with Facebook Login; Instagram Login channels return ChannelRefreshRequired. Buffer documents no OAuth scope for it.

audio_id.description: Meta audio asset id, from a search or trending result.

output.description: The audio, or a refresh request.
